items.title: Talking with Jason about Real Estate
items.content_html:
• license took 1 month, $1k, test, done.
  • hard part is getting started
    • no client base
    • no knowledge
  • 80% of agents fail
    • renewal rates show 80% don’t renew every 3 years (national “clock”)
    • no leads
  • Jason has a system for his agents
    • 14 people work for him

Advice #

  • find someone who is looking to grow agents
  • commit or don’t do it, but don’t quit
  • takes a month to learn
    • 3 months to ramp up
    • 2 months to close first house
    • first 6 months without a paycheck
  • takes 2 years to build it
  • would never go back to the car business
  • Century21 is in Appleton
    • jamesville
    • altuna
